rule_descriptions.MD001: Heading levels should only increment by one level at a time
rule_descriptions.MD005: Inconsistent indentation for list items at the same level
rule_descriptions.MD014: Dollar signs used before commands without showing output
rule_descriptions.MD018: No space after hash on atx style heading
rule_descriptions.MD019: Multiple spaces after hash on atx style heading
rule_descriptions.MD020: No space inside hashes on closed atx style heading
rule_descriptions.MD021: Multiple spaces inside hashes on closed atx style heading
rule_descriptions.MD022: Headings should be surrounded by blank lines
rule_descriptions.MD023: Headings must start at the beginning of the line.
rule_descriptions.MD024: Multiple headings with the same content
rule_descriptions.MD025: Multiple top-level headings in the same document
rule_descriptions.MD031: Fenced code blocks should be surrounded by blank lines
rule_descriptions.MD032: Lists should be surrounded by blank lines
rule_descriptions.MD036: Emphasis used instead of a heading
rule_descriptions.MD040: Fenced code blocks should have a language specified.
rule_descriptions.MD041: First line in a file should be a top-level heading.
rule_descriptions.MD044: Proper names should have the correct capitalization
rule_descriptions.MD045: Images should have alternate text (alt text)
rule_descriptions.MD047: Files should end with a single newline character.
rule_descriptions.MD052: Reference links and images should use a label that is defined
rule_descriptions.MD053: Link and image reference definitions should be needed
rule_descriptions.MD058: Tables should be surrounded by blank lines
